data_fields.name: roll_range
data_fields.donor_constant: urand(0,10000) inclusive (10001 values); chances in hundredths of a percent

data_fields.name: skill_bonus_per_point
data_fields.donor_constant: 4 (hundredths of a percent per attacker skill point over victim skill; lowers dodge, parry, block only)

data_fields.name: miss_width
data_fields.donor_constant: MeleeSpellMissChance (not read; passed in by wrapper)

data_fields.name: dodge_parry_block_widths
data_fields.donor_constant: from unit aura, skill and flag inputs (not read)

data_fields.name: armour_constant
data_fields.donor_constant: a = 0.1 x armour / (8.5 x L + 40); L + 4.5 per level above 59

best_idea: Resolve each swing with one server roll sorted into ordered outcome bands (miss, defence, glance, crush, crit, normal), let a skill gap shift only the defence bands, and apply each outcome's multiplier after armour.
decision_why: Ordered single-roll bands with per-outcome multipliers after armour are a fast-duel hit resolution the server can own and the client only displays; we drop WoW-specific rules (behind-the-back, sitting victim, NO_* flags, aura mods, cleanDamage bookkeeping), and parry and block take guard state as input.
acceptance: A server test sets miss 500, dodge 1000, crit 800, other widths 0, skill bonus 0, and asserts rolls 0-499 miss, 500-1499 dodge, 1500-2299 crit, 2300-9999 normal, plus one pinned armour value from the donor formula.
